rules.paraphrase: Attorney rate is 170 dollars an hour, 200 for medical and nursing-home malpractice, and paralegals are capped at 75.
Time charged by any attorney not on the Approved Attorney Register is removed before payment.
Only one approved attorney bills for reviewing the original file, capped at two hours.
Two approved attorneys may not bill separately for the same action or item.
Bills are submitted quarterly from assignment; any other bill is returned.
Items must be charged separately; a lumped entry with one total of hours is inappropriate.
The claim file number appears on every bill; travel and copy expenses are itemised with counts.
Copies at twenty cents; federal mileage rate; meals only for overnight travel; receipts for extraordinary expenses over 100 dollars.
A phone call charged above 0.3 hour must be explained in the next status letter.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Status reports are due every 120 days on inactive files.
All settlement offers from plaintiffs must be reported.
